query:
INSERT INTO job_events (
                job_id,
                run_number,
                attempt,
                event_type,
                stage,
                payload
             )
             VALUES (
                $1,
                $2,
                $3,
                'LEASED',
                $4,
                jsonb_build_object('worker_id', $5::text, 'lease_duration_seconds', $6::int4)
             )
